caption: The drawing depicts four rectangular swatches of woven fabric, arranged vertically in a single column on a plain, off-white background. The top swatch has a diagonal striped pattern featuring dark blue, brown, and gray colors. The second swatch has a herringbone pattern with predominantly brown and a few lighter blue threads interwoven. The third swatch is a horizontal striped pattern composed of red, purple, and some blue threads. The fourth, bottom swatch displays a checkered or grid-like pattern with alternating bands of red, blue, and green. All four fabric samples are of equal width and length, with space separating each swatch from the others.
title: Shaker Rug Binding Tapes
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
